smell_validity.evidence: Date/Error/RegExp handling is one traversal-leaf policy, yet the diff threads it as three loose booleans at 10-17 recursion sites across nine utilities, with eight naming schemes and clashing true-polarities, and even dismantles the bundled DeepReadonly options record into three flags; the clump and its silent-inversion cost are unmistakable.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Every recursion site in nine modules repeats three separately named booleans in four polarity dialects; adding a family or changing a default requires dozens of agreeing edits, and the DeepReadonly merge is spelled three times. A shared policy type would restore single ownership of the built-in-leaf decision.

development_plausibility.evidence: Defaulted trailing parameters, prettier formatting, per-module JSDoc and a rollout story of small independent PRs fit the library; but nine homogeneous trio-plus-Exclude rewrites in one cycle plus the deliberate teardown of the DeepReadonly record show faint engineered shape.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt pins the costliest wrong direction: each utility must descend into exactly the built-in families it does today. It bounds scope to the deep rewriting family, forbids new arguments, public-name changes and path-utility edits, preserves the DeepReadonly override record, and still leaves the representation open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Different code-supported decisions: reproduce four distinct default configurations; DeepRequired ErrorPolicy gates a structural Error branch instead of the leaf set; the DeepReadonly boundary lowers its override record into the unit; guard conditional tests and iterator-mapper layers carry the group in extra positions.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the family, so the nine lib/deep-* modules take one search; remaining work is local: enumerate each module forwarding positions including WeakMap/WeakSet guard tests and iterator mappers, and confirm composite and strict consumers rely on defaults. No cross-component gate.

repair_coordination.evidence: All nine default expressions and the DeepReadonly record lowering must share one policy semantics; a single flipped module silently changes computed types. Concrete partial repair: unify exported aliases while inner sites rely on defaults - compiles and passes all existing assertions, but configured users silently revert to defaults at recursion depth.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Forwarding sites collapse mechanically, but the nine helpers use four consumption orientations and four default sets, so one template covers only matching modules; the DeepRequired two-flag helper with its Error branch and the DeepReadonly enumerated union with record-based lowering resist any single rule.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Existing assertions use default arities only; the injection touched no test file. Inner sites that fall back to defaults pass every existing check yet give configured users silently wrong types once a non-default policy must survive recursion; DeepReadonly boundary or DeepRequired branch slips stay equally unchecked.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
